script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

Title: NEW LEASES

INT. MEDIA CONNECTIONS - DAY

Buzzing office filled with cubicles and open workspaces. Agents and associates work at their desks, making calls and typing on computers.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
(mellow, introspective)
In a world where change is the only constant, the media industry never rests.

Against the backdrop of the bustling office, two employees, JAMES and ANNA, share a coffee break.

JAMES
(looking tired)
I can't take this anymore. I feel like I'm stuck in a rut. I started in this business with a fire in my belly, but now... Now I feel like I'm just going through the motions.

ANNA
(smiling)
You've been in the industry for ten years now. It's natural to feel a little burnt out sometimes. But have you considered a career change?

JAMES
(laughs)
A career change? I've got a mortgage, a car payment, and a family to feed. I can't just up and quit and start over.

Anna nods sympathetically.

ANNA
I understand, but have you considered the possibilities? Have you looked into other areas of the media industry, or even completely different industries?

James shakes his head, unsure.

JAMES
No, I haven't. But where would I even begin?

INT. MEDIA CONNECTIONS - LATER

James sits at his desk, staring at his computer screen. He begins to browse job listings online.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
With the help of a friend, James starts to explore new opportunities.

INT. JAMES' APARTMENT - NIGHT

James sits at his kitchen table, surrounded by books and notes. He's researching potential career paths and industries.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
James' research leads him to discover a growing trend in media: digital content creation.

INT. MEDIA CONNECTIONS - DAY

James approaches his boss, MRS. KELLY, with an idea.

JAMES
Mrs. Kelly, I've been thinking about a new direction for our company. I've been researching digital content creation and I think we could really capitalize on this trend.

Mrs. Kelly listens intently.

MRS. KELLY
James, I appreciate your initiative, but this is a big change for us. We'll need to do some research and planning before we make any moves.

INT. JAMES' APARTMENT - NIGHT

James works late into the night, putting together a proposal for digital content creation.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
James spends nights and weekends refining his proposal, determined to make this change work.

INT. MEDIA CONNECTIONS - DAY

James presents his proposal to Mrs. Kelly and the executive team. They are impressed with his research and passion for the new direction.

MRS. KELLY
James, I have to admit, I'm impressed. This could be a real game-changer for us. Let's put together a team and get started.

James looks relieved and excited.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
With the support of his team, James embarks on a new journey in his career, proving that change can lead to growth and fulfillment.

FADE OUT.

THE END
